sloka: तत्र रावणमासीनमभिवाद्य कृताञ्जलिः ।आचचक्षे प्रियं पित्रे निहतौ रामलक्ष्मणौ ।। ६.४६.४७ ।।।।
transliteration: tatra rāvaṇamāsīnamabhivādya kṛtāñjaliḥ ।ācacakṣe priyaṁ pitre nihatau rāmalakṣmaṇau ।। 6.46.47 ।।।।

translations.english: In the midst of Rakshasas, Ravana hearing the news of his enemies being killed, rejoiced, and got up from his couch and embraced his son.
